Seat ruling (2026-11-22T10:17Z) on item 6's storage, which the card delegates to the seat (「第 6 项的存法请席位按现有结构调整」).

Measured by the card thread at 3faabd26: the record page header can carry pins only through page:header `actions` plus `maxVisible` on an AUTHORED record page, which means materializing the synthesized default page and freezing its layout. The list header bar has no carrier: it is the object's `list_toolbar` actions sorted by `order`, and `order` is shared by every page.

**Chosen: one new optional object key with a list arm and a record arm.** Each arm holds pinned action ids in order, at most 3. The rest go to 「More」. It is saved into the object's customization layer, as #36363's menu is, so installed objects work. Not chosen: materializing the record page, which freezes the layout, and a list-view key plus record-page materialization, which splits one choice across two carriers.

Conditions: the key is optional with no default, and an object without it draws exactly as today (pinned). Both header renderers read it in the same change, with a liveness row `live` citing both. An unknown or not-allowed action id is refused at save with a named reason. The name collides with no existing key (grep in the PR). Declaration: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`; the spec part comes first. The L2 runs on the schema face at the contract-review tier. The claim's Clause-② and file surface are amended when the thread posts its plan.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Seat ruling amendment (2026-11-22T14:36Z) to 7077698148, after the maintainer's two decisions in the action-format analysis thread (2026-11-22T14:27Z 「放在对象上,分列表和记录」 and 2026-11-22T14:33Z 「三类都由动作声明,分两步做」).

What changes from 7077698148:
- The object key holds one arm per action scope, `list` and `record`, and each arm is `{ pinned, more }`: `pinned` is at most 3 action ids in order, `more` is the order of the 「More」 menu. Working name `actionLayout`.
- The `record` arm is a scope, not a page. In this card it orders the record header, the side preview and the phone bar. The row menu and right-click follow in #36494.
- The card lands on today's `locations` words and does not touch `locations`. The vocabulary change is #36495 (next major), and the `selection` arm is #36496.

What stays: optional with no default (an object without the key draws exactly as today), written to the object's customization layer, both header renderers read it in the same change with a liveness row `live`, an unknown or not-allowed id is refused at save with a named reason, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, and a contract-tier L2 on the schema face.

Shown to the maintainer in examples and not objected to, but not ruled: the PR body names each as an assumption for review (the key name; an action in neither list goes to the end of 「More」 in today's order; a hidden pinned action leaves its slot empty; only list `$import` / `$export` among built-ins can be named; `.custom` replaces one arm whole; save refuses more than 3 pinned, a name in both lists, an unknown name, or an action of the other scope).

Owed in the same PR: a note in ADR-0085 §2 (the arms are scopes, admitted as a cross-surface role) and in ADR-0146 D10 (the paired `.custom` may re-arrange the base's own actions, beside the #35901 rule).

**Rebase first.** The branch sits on 651600593, a #36363 commit from before #36437 was squashed into main. Rebase with `git rebase --onto origin/main 651600593`. On today's main the first commit conflicts in three pin-count tests: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` and the two `object-*-echo-decisions.test.ts` under `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/`. Recount them, don't hand-edit them.

**Remaining, in order:**
1. Regenerate the spec baselines (api-surface, authorable-surface, export-origins, dropped-refinements counts, JSON schema), and the liveness `object/actionLayout` row drilled into list and record, pinned and more, citing the record header, list header, fold and design mode.
2. Rewrite the docs for the new shape: `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`, `data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`, `references/system/migration.mdx`; regenerate `references/data/object.mdx`.
3. Object form translations in the 11 locales of `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: labels List and Record, new help texts.
4. The i18n key `designMode.pins.stale` in every hand-written `@object-ui/i18n` locale, zh-Hant generated; run the i18n gates.
5. Notes in ADR-0085 §2 (arms are scopes, a cross-surface role) and ADR-0146 D10 (the paired `.custom` may re-arrange the base's actions).
6. The changeset text for the new shape.
7. Header-level tests for the `more` order (record ⋯, list toolbar ⋯), the phone bar (`face: 'bar'`) and the side preview reading the arm.
8. Gates (`dispatch-gates --commands` and `--ran`, overlap-check) and a live run.
9. The PR body names the assumptions (key name; record arm = header, preview and phone bar; unnamed actions to the end of More; a hidden pinned action leaves its slot empty; no arm = today; only list `$import`/`$export`; `.custom` replaces an arm whole; an authored header list of its own wins; save refusals; stale names listed in the panel and skipped by the reader). Out of scope: #36494, #36495, #36496. Skills-docs follow-up owed on `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`. Contract tier L2; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`.
